title: Path Reversal
description: Turn path blocks back into their previous block state (podzol -> path block -> podzol) by right clicking it with a shovel.
body:
# Path Reversal

This mod lets you turn a path block back into it's previous block state (podzol -> path block -> podzol) by right clicking it with a shovel. Complete with sound, 1 damage to your shovel (unbreaking compatible) for each block changed, and server support! Report any issues on the github repo. 

# Example

![Showcasing mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e231df4513a7689c5f2298f10f6da4936a7ad581.gif)

## Server
You only need this on the server, players do not need to install the mod.
